scope: Post-hoc descriptive re-analysis of existing frozen outer-fold class predictions, fixed before inspecting joint error counts. Existing aggregate performance and prior confidence intervals are already known.
outputs: Joint correctness 2x2 counts and fused correct counts in each cell
For each branch: wrong-to-correct repairs, correct-to-wrong losses, net accuracy count and absolute-grade-error change
Same descriptive counts by truth grade and outer fold
All six pooled performance metrics and confusion matrices; source report parity
interpretation: Different branch errors and actual fusion repairs are descriptive evidence consistent with complementary predictions. They do not prove a positive interaction, unique auxiliary-loss contribution, causation, external generalization or clinical utility. Compare the natural-CORAL pair too. Do not infer interaction from separate significance decisions or add historical component gains.
